title: The vacuum--fourth-chaos Ritz eigenvalue has leading correction minus g sigma_N

ritz_asymptotic.basis: Use the orthonormal basis e0=1 and e1=V_N/sigma_N in the two-dimensional form subspace
ritz_asymptotic.centered_matrix: For K_N^proj=H_N-6gC_N^2=H0+gV_N the exact compression is [[0,g sigma_N],[g sigma_N,d_N]], where d_N=h_N/sigma_N^2+g m3_N/sigma_N^2
ritz_asymptotic.diagonal_order: K1479 gives h_N/sigma_N^2<=4 omega_max(N)=O(N), while K1483 gives 0<=m3_N/sigma_N^2<=72S_N=O(N); hence 0<=d_N=O(N)
ritz_asymptotic.leading_order: Because sigma_N=Theta(N^(5/2)) and d_N=O(N), lambda_N^-=-g sigma_N+O(N), equivalently lambda_N^-/(g sigma_N)->-1
ritz_asymptotic.eigenvector: Choosing the normalized lower Ritz eigenvector u_N=alpha_N e0+beta_N e1 with alpha_N>0 gives beta_N/alpha_N=lambda_N^-/(g sigma_N)->-1 and alpha_N->1/sqrt(2), beta_N->-1/sqrt(2)
ritz_asymptotic.weak_limit: K1480 gives e1 weakly to zero, so u_N converges weakly to the nonzero vacuum vector 1/sqrt(2)
ritz_asymptotic.ceiling: This is the exact asymptotic of the two-dimensional Ritz value and an upper bound on E_N only. It supplies no matching lower bound, exact ground-state asymptotic, compactness, recovery sequence or common nonlinear continuum domain
